subject: draw multiple data frame on a single coordinate

messages.author: 6172ba5a43c33a66
messages.subject: draw multiple data frame on a single coordinate
parts:
I've already use ggplot draw a scatter plot. Now I have another data
frame, want to draw on the same plot, but to keep the previous
drawing. Both of them have the same structure, so they are compatible.
Is there a way to do this?

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: draw multiple data frame on a single coordinate
parts:
This plots data from two separate data frames on the same plot:

data1 <- data.frame(x1=runif(5), y1=runif(5))
data2 <- data.frame(x2=runif(5), y2=runif(5))
qplot(x1,y1,data=data1)+geom_point(data=data2,aes(x2,y2),color="red")

In general, though, you'll be happier using ggplot if everything is in
the same data frame, if at all possible.

Ben
